Sam: Quick question — I'm proposing a tiny change to the chat/completions contract: add an optional top-level "tools" array that aggregates tool/function call metadata emitted while streaming. Will this be a breaking change for SDKs?

Anya: can you sketch the shape? If it's optional and we don't remove anything clients read today, should be fine.

Sam: sketch below. idea is to keep existing `choices[].delta` behavior for streaming but also include a single `tools` list at the end so non-streaming consumers can see all tool outputs in one place.

Sam: ```json
{
  "id": "...",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "choices": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "delta": { "content": "Hello" },
      "finish_reason": null
    }
  ],
  "tools": [
    { "name": "search", "invocation_id": "inv-123", "payload": { "hits": 3 } },
    { "name": "calc", "invocation_id": "inv-124", "payload": { "result": 42 } }
  ]
}
```

Devon: Two quick compatibility notes: 1) keep `tools` optional — older clients ignore unknown fields fine. 2) streaming SDKs that parse per-delta will continue working; add-on clients that expect a single final message should look for `tools` at final event.

Marta: How do we signal the final event in streaming? We currently send `finish_reason` on the last chunk, but some clients only look at `choices[].message` for end state.

Sam: plan: include `final_event: true` on the last streaming chunk and also emit a final non-streaming envelope (same id) with `tools` and `choices` consolidated. That keeps both flows supported.

Anya: +1. Suggest also adding a `spec_version` field in the top-level response so SDKs can gate parsing logic: e.g. `spec_version: "2026-03-17-1"`.

Devon: Agree. Also make `tools[].invocation_id` stable and documented — some integrations will need that to correlate logs.

Sam: One more: for function/tool calling semantics, keep current `choices[].message.function_call` shape but allow a 1:many mapping where a single function call can spawn multiple `tools` entries (invocation + plugin outputs). Example in final envelope.

Marta: any perf/regression concerns? emitting `tools` duplicates some data that was streamed earlier.

Sam: small duplicate bytes for final envelope, but it's only on final event. We can make final envelope option gated by feature flag for Dedicated/Private customers first.

ops-bot: deployment queued: api/protocol-spec V2 -> staging (build 612). :gear:

Anya: Can someone add a short note in the API changelog and update SDK parsers to check `spec_version` before reading `tools`? I'll file the SDK tasks.

Devon: I'll send a short PR to runtime to add `final_event: true` and final-envelope emission behind a toggle. ping me for code review when ready.

Sam: thanks — I'll add examples in docs and the migration guide. @Anya @Devon please review the examples. :thumbsup:

Marta: LGTM, catching up on the thread now. If tests look good, we can roll to canary tomorrow.

Sam: sounds good — updated the draft PR with the json sample and spec_version.

Devon: PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/protocol-spec/pulls/76 (review requested).

Sam: awesome, thanks everyone.
